subject.title: Feature request: config option to suppress sub-agent announce

question: Should deterministic completion suppression use one unified policy with a global default and per-spawn override, or remain limited to a single scope?
rationale: The capability is genuinely missing, but discussion proposes overlapping boolean, enum, parent-routing, and per-channel surfaces; adding public config or tool parameters requires a canonical contract and precedence decision.

options.title: Unified policy
options.body: Use one small completion-policy enum with current behavior as the default and permit a per-spawn override of the global sub-agent default.

options.title: Per-spawn only
options.body: Add only a `sessions_spawn` suppression override, avoiding persistent config but requiring every orchestrator call to opt out.

options.title: Routing design first
options.body: Defer suppression until parent and channel routing are designed together with the related open proposals.

recommendation.title: Unified policy
recommendation.body: Use one small completion-policy enum with current behavior as the default and permit a per-spawn override of the global sub-agent default.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the tool and announce behavior and authored the major delivery-pipeline refactor, making him the strongest history-backed contract owner.
